label: NMM Steel
description: Steel and silver read as cold, hard metal through sharp value contrast on a neutral-to-cool grey scale, the cool counterpart to NMM Gold. Keep saturation low throughout — steel is about value contrast, not hue.
notes: Steel's whole ladder sits closer together in hue than gold's — the read comes almost entirely from how sharp the value jumps are, not from color variety.
Push the Deep Shadow further into blue than feels natural; a too-neutral dark shadow reads as grey plastic, not polished metal.
The Specular Reflection is smaller and harder-edged than on gold. Steel has a tighter, more mirror-like highlight because it's a smoother, less warm-toned surface.
Reuse Deep Shadow and Shadow for recesses even away from the main light source, the same way as NMM Gold — metal reflects its dark surroundings, not just local shading.
